title: Lead Business Analyst
jobDescription:

LeadSquared is a B2B SaaS CRM and marketing automation platform that helps sales and marketing teams across industries capture, engage, and convert leads efficiently. Headquartered in Bengaluru, LeadSquared serves customers across BFSI, healthcare, education, and other high-growth sectors.

• Own ad-hoc analyses and projects requested by leadership, translating business questions into structured data outputs.

• Working knowledge of LeadSquared (LS) lead/opportunity management, workflows, automation, and reporting modules.

• 2 - 4 years of experience in Business Operations, Sales/Revenue Operations, or a related analytical role, preferably in B2B SaaS.

• Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of SQL and/or Power BI is a strong plus.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business narratives.

• Strong communication skills comfortable presenting findings to cross-functional and senior stakeholders.

• Process-oriented mindset with attention to detail and a bias for structured documentation.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Commerce, Statistics, or a related field.

PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE

• Prior experience configuring or administering a CRM platform (LeadSquared, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).

• Exposure to automation tools (Power Automate, Zapier) or basic scripting (Python/JavaScript).

• Experience supporting MBR/QBR cycles or executive scorecards.

WHAT WE OFFER

• The opportunity to work at the intersection of data, strategy, and technology in a fast-growing SaaS company.

• Direct visibility with cross-functional leadership and a hands-on role in shaping how the business runs.

• A collaborative, ownership-driven culture based out of our Bangalore office.
